messages:
nate_s: Heads up 1: Field integrator (SI: BlueDock) on HelixHealth install hit a hard block pulling runtime image from the marketplace. Error: TLS handshake failure + connection reset. They reported image URL and their infra team says outbound allowlist is strict.

anya_se: Oof. Do they have a proxy that rewrites Host header? That kills our CDN cert chain sometimes.

kevin_partner: Partner confirms corporate proxy rewrites host => they map marketplace.redwood.ai -> internal.proxy.local. We suspect SNI mismatch + cert pinning on our side.

lia_ops: Can we provide an alternate signed endpoint on a fixed IP? Their proxy only allows IP-based allowlist for downloads.

sam_p: Alternate IP is problematic. Our signing infra is behind CDN and uses dynamic IPs. Short-term: we can create an ephemeral signed bundle hosted on partner-facing static IPs for this customer. Need approval from security/legal for an exception.

marketplace-bot: Notice: Static-ip download endpoints are supported for accredited partners under partner-network. See https://redwood.cloud/marketplace/static-downloads (policy v2).

anya_se: If security OK with exception, we should also provide a SHA512 checksum and a PGP-signed manifest so their OPS can verify integrity even if TLS is terminated at proxy.

kevin_partner: BlueDock field team prefers tarball + manifest. They can fetch over their allowed IPs. ETA for field pull: tomorrow morning customer local time.

nate_s: This customer has a co-marketing case study slated for Friday. If install slips, marketing needs to know. @jess_marketing please advise on messaging cadence.

jess_marketing: Thanks. If go-live slips >24h we'll postpone the joint field announcement. Send me final by 9am PT tomorrow and we'll reline assets.

sam_p: Action items:
- lia_ops to provision ephemeral signed bundle on partner-net static IPs (IP: 34.198.123.45) and provide URL + checksum by EOD PT.
- anya_se to prepare PGP-signed manifest and thumbprint.
- kevin_partner to coordinate BlueDock field pull window and confirm proxy config.

lia_ops: Begin upload now to partner-bucket, will set TTL 48h and restrict to BlueDock agent. URL will be shared in DM.

nate_s: Also flagging this as "si-field-ip-allowlist" in incident tracker, tagging eng-infra for follow-up to support long-term static endpoint option.

anya_se: Quick note for the arch review: we should update marketplace docs to include guidance for customers with IP allowlists and proxies that rewrite SNI/Host. Small doc PR queued.

kevin_partner: Field pulled successfully in staging at 02:30 UTC; awaiting production window. Will confirm after prod test.

jess_marketing: Appreciate the heads up. Keep me posted; I'll standby to flip the announcement. :white_check_mark:
